nodes.label: Stripe Connect production go-live checklist
Platform/marketplace with Express connected accounts
Production webhook endpoint registration (Connect + payments) and signing secrets
stripe-connect-webhook — account.updated / account.application.deauthorized
stripe-webhook — checkout/payment_intent lifecycle events
Rationale: server-side Stripe runs in edge functions, so STRIPE_SECRET_KEY is never needed in Vercel
Onboarding redirect origin falls back to https://portal.drive-247.com
Connect branding for connected accounts (name, icon, brand colour)
Connected-account payout schedule and minimum payout
Production troubleshooting: payments not reaching connected account; onboarding links expire after 24h
Stripe Connect end-to-end test scenario matrix
Test: create a tenant's connected account and confirm payouts enabled
Automated payment mode: charge transfers straight to the tenant's connected account
Manual-approval mode: card hold (requires_capture) then staff capture activates the rental
Pre-auth rejection releases the hold and cancels payment + rental with no money moved
Refunds use reverse_transfer, pulling money back out of the tenant's Stripe balance
Scheduled refund processed later by a cron job (refund_status scheduled → completed)
Tenants without Stripe Connect cannot create a checkout session at all
Stripe CLI --forward-connect-to for local Connect webhook testing
create-connected-account edge function
get-connect-onboarding-link edge function
create-checkout-session edge function (tenant resolved via x-tenant-slug)
tenants table (Stripe Connect columns: stripe_account_id, stripe_onboarding_complete, stripe_account_status)
payments table (status, capture_status, refund_status, stripe_payment_intent_id, stripe_refund_id)
Migration off the ex-partner "Cortek US" Stripe account onto a self-owned account
Decision: the new platform account is UAE-domiciled
Gotcha: Connect is not self-serve in UAE and US-based operators cannot onboard to a UAE platform
Config-identical twin: blueprint-export the old account, recreate products/prices/coupons by API
tenants.stripe_platform_account ('uk' | 'ae') — per-tenant platform-account routing
Extend _shared/stripe-client.ts to resolve keys/secrets by (mode, account)
One webhook URL serves both platform accounts by verifying against both signing secrets
The _AE Supabase secret family (live/test secret, publishable, webhook, connect, subscription)
Per-tenant cutover: PAN copy, recreate subscription, re-onboard Connect, flip the routing flag
Constraint: history, balance and payouts always stay on the old account; operators need fresh KYC/bank
Retire the old account and drop the 'uk' branch from routing code
